description: Estimate 2026 take-home pay for one paycheck in California, New York, Illinois, Texas, Florida, Nevada, Tennessee, Wyoming, South Dakota, Alaska, New Hampshire, or Washington. Federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare, and that state's withholding use the same figures as auracalcs.com. Returns the paycheck lines, a link to the matching page, the publications and the date they were checked, and a disclaimer. Estimate only.

amount.description: Pay amount in dollars, before tax. Annual salary, one gross paycheck, or an hourly wage.

fedStep3Credits.description: Form W-4 Step 3 credits for the year.

fedStep4a.description: Form W-4 Step 4(a) other income for the year.

fedStep4b.description: Form W-4 Step 4(b) deductions for the year.

fedStep4cExtra.description: Form W-4 Step 4(c) extra withholding on this paycheck.

filingStatus.description: Form W-4 Step 1(c). New York estimates single and married filing jointly only.

hoursPerWeek.description: Used when payBasis is hourly. Defaults to 40.

nyLocality.description: New York local tax. Ignored for other states.

nySdiDeducted.description: Whether the New York employer deducts SDI. Paid Family Leave is still estimated.

payFrequency.description: How often this paycheck is paid.

state.description: Work state. The page for that state is linked in the result.

stateAllowances.description: California DE 4 allowances, New York IT-2104 exemptions (0 to 10), or Illinois IL-W-4 line 1. States without an income tax ignore this.

weeksPerYear.description: Used when payBasis is hourly. Defaults to 52.

ytdGross.description: Gross pay already received this year. Used only for Social Security and Additional Medicare on this paycheck.

name: calculate_paycheck
title: Estimate a 2026 paycheck
